findings.claim: A module outside lib/platform/paths.mjs reads OS home/temp locations directly, violating the platform paths requirement.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion `No environment or literal locations` says "No module in this repository other than `lib/platform/paths.mjs` SHALL read a home or temp location from the environment or from a literal." The diff imports `node:os` in `lib/platform/paths.test.mjs` and calls `os.homedir()` at line 12 and `os.tmpdir()` at line 18.
findings.suggested_fix: Either change the spec to explicitly exempt this test, or refactor paths.mjs to support injectable OS delegates so default-delegation behavior can be tested without another module calling `os.homedir()`/`os.tmpdir()`.
